Let Odoo fill in the unit price automatically. Save the quotation and report: (a) the product name you chose, (b) the unit price Odoo filled in, (c) the untaxed amount the quotation computes, and (d) the quotation reference/name (e.g. S00042). Note: this Odoo app long-polls and is never network-idle, so wait for concrete page state rather than waiting for network idle.

args.expression: (() => { const f = document.querySelector('.o_form_view'); const btns = [...document.querySelectorAll('.o_control_panel button, .o_form_statusbar button, .o_cp_buttons button')].map(b=>b.textContent.trim()+(b.offsetParent?'':' (hidden)')); return {formClass: f.className, buttons: btns, editableMode: !!document.querySelector('.o_form_view.o_form_editable')}; })()

(() => { const b = document.querySelector('.o_form_button_edit'); return b ? {found:true, text:b.textContent.trim(), visible: !!b.offsetParent, href:b.outerHTML.slice(0,200)} : {found:false, allButtons: [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].map(x=>x.className).filter(c=>c.includes('form_button'))}; })()

(() => { const out=[]; document.querySelectorAll('button').forEach((b,i)=>{ const t=b.textContent.trim(); if(/edit|save|discard/i.test(t)||/form_button/.test(b.className)) out.push({i, text:t, cls:b.className, vis:!!b.offsetParent}); }); return out; })()

(() => { const out=[]; document.querySelectorAll('button, a.btn').forEach((b,i)=>{ if(!b.offsetParent) return; out.push({i, text:b.textContent.trim().slice(0,30), title:b.getAttribute('title')||'', aria:b.getAttribute('aria-label')||'', cls:b.className.slice(0,60)}); }); return out; })()

(() => { const addP = [...document.querySelectorAll('a,button')].filter(e=>/Add a product/i.test(e.textContent)&&e.offsetParent); const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.o_field_x2many_list tbody tr.o_data_row')]; return { addProduct: addP.map(e=>({tag:e.tagName, cls:e.className, txt:e.textContent.trim()})), rowCount: rows.length, rowHTML: rows.map(r=>r.innerHTML.slice(0,300)), editBtn: [...document.querySelectorAll('.o_cp_buttons button')].map(b=>b.outerHTML.slice(0,150)), breadcrumb: document.querySelector('.o_breadcrumb')?.outerHTML.slice(0,400) }; })()
